name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – Before § 1 – Am 37
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: -1a. Stresses that it is the promotion of peace, cooperation and compliance with the principles of the UN Charter and the Final Act of the Helsinki Conference that serves the interests of the peoples of Europe and not the promotion of militarism, arms escalation and war;
